title: Exception-handling rule after a bug fix
description: Modelled on DESIGN.md §7.2.1's second example — 'a bug fixed on day 2 that day 4 must not re-introduce'. Day 1 fixes a bug and records the rule that prevents it recurring; day 4 must state the rule before writing new code, without the bug or the rule being restated anywhere in the day-4 prompt.
day1_prompt: Day 1: we found and fixed a bug — a retry loop used a bare `except:` and silently swallowed a KeyboardInterrupt. Decide and record the rule: always catch a specific exception class, never a bare except.
memory_sentence: This project's rule: never use a bare except, always catch a specific exception class.
day_n_prompt: Day 4: before writing new error-handling code, state the exception-handling rule this project follows, in one sentence.
